description: Tiger and Tiger compatibility in the Chinese zodiac: the same animal, their Wood elements, yin-yang, and what helps the pairing.
answer: In Chinese astrology, two Tigers share the same branch, Wood element and Yang polarity, so the match is read as a mirror. Each recognises the other's courage, independence and magnetic energy; the pairing tends to work best when the shared blind spot, the Tiger's impulsiveness, is named early.
ogLine: Two Tigers often form a bold, passionate and adventurous partnership in which each admires the other's courage.

sections.heading: How two Tigers relate
paragraphs: The Tiger tends to bring passion, protectiveness and adventurous energy to a relationship. It often champions its partner and makes life feel bold. On first meeting, the Tiger often comes across as charismatic, bold and energising. Traditional readings associate the Tiger with courage, independence and magnetic energy, and in a same-animal pair that quality is present twice. What the Tiger tends to value most in a partner is courage, honesty and the confidence to let it roam without jealousy. Spontaneity, physical play and fearless honesty usually keep a Tiger's interest alive.

Two Tigers may have been born in the same year or twelve, twenty-four or more years apart, so their year elements can differ even though the animal is shared. The Tiger usually needs freedom, respect and honesty, along with a partner confident enough not to feel threatened by its independence. Both partners usually need this at once, which can be a source of deep understanding or of competition for the same thing. Friends often notice that two Tigers share habits as well as values, from how they handle plans to how they greet strangers.

sections.heading: What the tradition says about a same-animal pair
paragraphs: When both partners are Tigers, the Chinese zodiac pairs an animal with itself. Classical tables do not list same-animal pairs among the harmonies or clashes; traditional readings instead describe them as mirrors, in which the Tiger's courage, independence and magnetic energy is shared and so are its blind spots. Two Tigers often form a bold, passionate and adventurous partnership in which each admires the other's courage. Life together rarely feels dull. The risk is clashes of will and competing needs for independence. Pairs of Tigers tend to do best when they face challenges together rather than testing each other.

Every Tiger shares the Fire trine with the Horse and Dog, has the Pig as its Liu He secret friend, and sits opposite the Monkey in the six clashes. Because the Tiger pairs with itself here, the Fire trine still frames the relationship: both partners share the same natural allies and the same opposite. In the traditional double-hour clock, the Tiger also names the hours from 3 am to 5 am.

sections.heading: Five elements and yin-yang
paragraphs: Two Tigers share Wood as their fixed element. In five-element thinking a shared element is read as mutual recognition, so each Tiger tends to understand the other's instincts, with the caution that the same strengths and excesses are doubled. As Yang animals, two Tigers share the same polarity, outward and active in traditional terms. In five-element terms the Tiger's Wood is associated with growth and flexibility, a quality two Tigers hold in common.

In everyday terms, the shared Wood of the Tiger and the Tiger suggests the Tiger and the Tiger who grow by encouraging each other, generous with ideas and plans, but who may both overextend. Each birth year also carries its own element from the heavenly stems, so a Metal Tiger and a Water Tiger read slightly differently, and two Tigers born exactly twelve years apart will have year elements one step apart in the cycle. For example, the Tiger year of 2010 was a Metal year and the Tiger year of 2022 a Water year, so two Tigers born in those years differ in flavour.

sections.heading: Friction and what helps two Tigers
paragraphs: Under stress, the Tiger can become impulsive, hot-tempered or restless, pushing back hard against anything that feels like control. When both partners respond this way at once, the pattern tends to amplify rather than balance out. After an argument, the Tiger usually wants to clear the air directly and move on, and a Tiger who speaks frankly earns its respect.

Between two Tigers, friction often flares as a clash of wills, loud, passionate and quickly over. Neither enjoys backing down in public. Agreeing to settle disputes privately, and to cool off with physical activity first, tends to keep two fierce temperaments from escalating.

What helps with a Tiger is directness, shared challenges and giving it room to cool off before revisiting a disagreement. For two Tigers, agreeing in advance who will step back first when the Tiger's impulsiveness appears can keep a shared trait from becoming a shared problem, and taking turns in that role keeps it fair.

sections.heading: Two Tigers day to day
paragraphs: At home, the Tiger tends to want both closeness and freedom, appreciating a Tiger who supports its independence and shares its adventures. Sports gear, maps and souvenirs from bold trips tend to accumulate wherever a Tiger lives. Two Tigers often live at full volume, trading dares, planning expeditions and defending each other fiercely. Quiet evenings together may feel unfamiliar at first, yet they give two restless spirits a chance to recharge side by side instead of competing.

Traditionally the Tiger usually enjoys adventurous, active outings such as hiking, competitive sport, travel and anything with a challenge, which two Tigers can enjoy side by side. As a colleague, the Tiger leads bold initiatives and defends the team; beside the Tiger, it supplies courage and decisive energy. Crises, launches and causes that need a champion are where the Tiger often shines brightest. On a shared team, two Tigers tend to reinforce each other's courage, which is a real asset once roles are clearly divided.

faq.question: Are the Tiger and the Tiger compatible in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Classical tables do not rate same-animal pairs as harmonies or clashes. Two Tigers tend to understand each other quickly and share the same blind spot, the Tiger's impulsiveness, so awareness matters more than any rating.

faq.question: What are the elements of the Tiger?
faq.answer: The Tiger's fixed element is Wood and its polarity is Yang. Each birth year adds a separate year element from the heavenly stems.

faq.question: Which animals are best for the Tiger?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Horse and Dog share the Tiger's San He trine and the Pig is its Liu He secret friend.

faq.question: What might the Tiger and the Tiger enjoy doing together?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Tiger usually enjoys adventurous, active outings such as hiking, competitive sport, travel and anything with a challenge. Two Tigers often enjoy these side by side, and taking turns to choose keeps plans fresh.

faq.question: Does the Chinese zodiac use the calendar year?
faq.answer: No. Animal years begin at Lunar New Year: the Tiger year of 2022 began on February 1, and the one before it, in 2010, on February 14, so January birthdays need checking. The calculator does this automatically.
